items.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
items.excerpt: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.

items.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
items.excerpt: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

items.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
items.excerpt: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.excerpt: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

items.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
items.excerpt: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

items.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
items.excerpt: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

items.title: Dozens of oil and shipping tankers hacked in recent weeks, per report
items.excerpt: Iran is the chief suspect behind the dozens of cyberattacks targeting oil and chemical shipping vessels.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
items.excerpt: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

items.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
items.excerpt: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.

items.title: Threads comes to iPad and takes a page from X’s playbook with cashtags
items.excerpt: The addition of live stock quotes and charts could help Threads attract the financial community that has historically relied on X.

items.title: Electric truck startup Harbinger gets financing boost from Palmer Luckey’s bank
items.excerpt: Harbinger has tapped Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank as a new source of capital as the electric truck startup looks to diversify how it funds its growth.

items.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs

items.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
items.excerpt: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

items.title: Uber and Nuro begin driverless testing of Lucid robotaxis ahead of 2027 launch
items.excerpt: Uber and Nuro have started testing driverless Lucid Gravity SUVs on public streets in the San Francisco Bay Area.

items.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
items.excerpt: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.

items.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
items.excerpt: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.

items.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
items.excerpt: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

items.title: Huang reportedly admitted to more than two affairs to Nvidia’s board

items.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers
